fusions.name: Vaulting Thrust
fusions.desc: You leap up to 6 tiles to the target and thrust, dealing 12 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Tines Abroad
fusions.desc: Flings 3 prongs in a fan, each dealing 3 damage with a 25% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Haft Vault
fusions.desc: Plants the haft and vaults 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Chasing Prong
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, a prong flies to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 4 damage. Once every 6 seconds. You gain +6% dodge chance.
